about_the_game:
Expansion pack #4 focuses on tactical warfare. The value of the cards in this pack can very from turn to turn, even from move to move!

This pack introduces Tactical cards, which are a lot stronger than normal Action cards. It also features the strongest Unit yet and a very powerful draw card, that can potentially be acquired for as little as 1 Energy!

Tactical

The first Tactical card you play in a turn is like a normal Action card, but each one after that, in the same turn, has to be supported. This means you have to be selective about which ones you want for your deck, but when you are, you will be feared.

"I don't always buy Infantry, but when I do, I flip them."

Mid-range Power

Are you an action junkie? You will be sure to get a lot of bang for your buck with Tactical Unit. Being the only Unit that can have 4 Attack right away (5 when supported), you don't need many of them to deliver a lethal blow. Since they are in Tier 2 they can also come out surprisingly quickly.

War Innovation

Does war really drive innovation? Just try not to get destroyed by your own invention!
